episodes.title: Aniq
episodes.summary: Following a shocking death at a high school reunion's afterparty, Detective Danner grills Aniq, who recounts the night like a rom-com.

episodes.title: Brett
episodes.summary: In Brett's action-packed retelling of the night, he had one goal in attending the reunion: reconcile with his ex-wife to get their family back together

episodes.title: Yasper
episodes.summary: Yasper explains how he tried to get Xavier to help him get his music career off the ground. His version of the events is a toe-tapping musical.

episodes.title: Chelsea
episodes.summary: Chelsea reveals her not-so-innocent motive: revenge, plain and simple. Her recollection is a tense psychological thriller.

episodes.title: High School
episodes.summary: Everyone's stories trace back to a high school party from 15 years ago, which Walt recounts to Detective Danner—revealing huge secrets.

episodes.title: Zoë
episodes.summary: Zoë confesses she came to the reunion for a wild night out— a break from her divorced, single-mom life. Things get animated in her retelling.

episodes.title: Danner
episodes.summary: As her unconventional methods land her in hot water, Detective Danner looks to her own past to explain why she needs to crack this case.

episodes.title: Maggie
episodes.summary: Season finale. An unexpected eyewitness emerges to help Detective Danner piece together the true story behind Xavier's demise.

episodes.title: Aniq 2: The Sequel
episodes.summary: When Zoe's sister's wedding weekend is destroyed by a murder, Aniq calls his old friend Danner to investigate the crime.

episodes.title: Grace
episodes.summary: Aniq and Danner interview the bride, who tells the story of her relationship with Edgar in the style of a Jane Austen romance.

episodes.title: Travis
episodes.summary: Grace's former boyfriend tells his story like a film noir: He suspected that Edgar was up to no good and was determined to protect his ex.

episodes.title: Hannah
episodes.summary: Like the heroine of a twee indie film, Edgar's adopted sister wanted to stop the wedding because of her own broken heart.

episodes.title: Sebastian
episodes.summary: When Edgar's business partner opens up about their complicated history, it plays like a slick and suspenseful heist movie.

episodes.title: Danner's Fire
episodes.summary: Why did Danner really leave the police force? She presents the scintillating story to Aniq like a steamy '90s thriller.

episodes.title: Ulysses
episodes.summary: Aniq and Danner move the investigation to Zoe's family, starting with her free-spirited uncle. His tale is an epic, global romance.

episodes.title: Feng
episodes.summary: Zoe's father reluctantly agrees to sit with her, Aniq, and Danner as they review found-footage-style videos from the weekend.

episodes.title: Isabel
episodes.summary: Launching into a '50s psychological melodrama, Edgar's mother details her nightmarish year since the death of her husband.

episodes.title: Vivian and Zoe
episodes.summary: Season finale. Alternating between campy horror and '80s soap opera, Zoe and her mother fill in the remaining blanks of Edgar's murder.
